updates.heading: Reading Stephen King
paragraphs: I don't have much to report at the moment. Just trying to stay warm in the approaching dead of winter. Reading is my main year-round hobby - I'm nearly finished with my first Stephen King book: Fairy Tale. It's been a very easy read, as long as it is. I love a good long story. This Autumn I read a final book in a trilogy that I'd had high hopes for but that had really let me down, and I'm feeling a bit heartbroken from it still. I needed something like this to restore some enjoyment in reading.
